# TopologyDependentEmergence

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where the specific connectivity graph (e.g., small-world, scale-free, random) determines whether and how polychronous groups form and stabilize. Guides topology design in TCC architectures to optimize emergent computational capabilities rather than relying solely on synaptic weight training.
